title: Compressor
summary: Lightning fast, super lightweight and clean video compressor
description:
Stop waiting for video compression.

Most apps are filled with annoying ads, track your data, and take 20 minutes to process a single clip. Compressor changes that. Built as a native Android utility, it uses your phone's hardware to shrink videos in seconds—not minutes.

WHY CHOOSE COMPRESSOR?
• Lightning Fast: Turn gigabytes into megabytes instantly. 
• Ad-Free: No full-screen videos or annoying banners. Just a tool that works.
• Privacy First: No internet permission required. Your videos never leave your device.
• Easy Sharing: Perfect for Discord, WhatsApp, and Email file limits.
• Clean UI: A modern, simple design that supports Dark Mode and Tablets.

ADVANCED FEATURES (FREE)
• High, Medium, and Low quality presets.
• Custom target-size slider (e.g. "Make this 10MB").
• Choose your resolution and framerate.
• Efficient H.265 (HEVC) and AV1 support*.

WORKS ON YOUR PHONE**
Whether you have the latest flagship or a 2016 classic, Compressor is optimized to run smoothly on devices as old as Android 7.0.

No tracking. No subscriptions. No bloat. Just the fastest compressor on Android.

*H.265 and AV1 support requires a compatible device
**Compressor requires a device running Android 7.0 or later with hardware accelerated video encoding and decoding support
